connections.description: Kit through-cuts and engagement-cuts in their source owners. Kit head rim needed an additional subtraction of the exact returned hardware envelope from bottom_panel; not a hand-designed printed thread.
Seats are integral material in blue_spine and lid, not glue-on blocks. Four7x3 magnets with0.6mm retaining membranes and2.2mm magnetic face gap; check polarity and holding force physically.

Metal M4x20 through rear post clearance hole; inner11x12x2 steel pad,2mm bridge,2mm washer and4mm metal thumb nut. Rear keyed tab resists bracket rotation. Metal thread only; no printed screw engagement.

M4x12 through2mm lower pad+2mm bridge+2.6mm steel sleeve+1.4mm washer+4mm metal nut. Eye hasØ6.4 bore and2mm foot; sleeveOD6 supplies0.2radial and0.6total axial play. Nut clamps sleeve, never loosened to swivel. Removable metal thread retention and witness marks; prototype validation required.
Custom304 assembly:3mm upright welded to2mm foot. CAD fused nominal interface; weld bead and fabrication drawing not released; inspect and load-test weld before use.

Each3x100x182.4 rectangular panel slides down3.6mm front/rear grooves. Bottom seats atZ4, closed roof limits lifting, rear ledge and metal bracket have pass-through slots for extraction after opening.

Independent30x1 flexible wrap, front/top/back/bottom. Front release slit atZ100;28x28 peelable lap below square pull frame. Stitch upper lap, removable lower hook-and-loop engagement; remove wrap before opening. CAD is closed envelope, not rigid printable loop.
Only non-load-bearing spine marks use compatible thin adhesive. No shoulder strap included.
